title: Fetch Worker0 stocks.json in backend and use it for Stocks asset search (no merge/sort/batching)

requirements.text: Implement a backend canister flow to fetch Worker 0 stocks JSON from `api.assetsbag.com/stocks.json` in a single HTTP outcall (no batching/chunking), then store the returned JSON response body as-is for later inspection/use (same overall fetch→validate→store pattern used for FIAT/Commodities).

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a permission-gated update method that fetches the Worker0 stocks endpoint in a single request and stores the raw response body without transforming/merging/sorting.

Backend stores a latest validation/inspection record for this Worker0 stocks fetch, including at least: requestedUrl, timestamp, rawResponseBody, validationStatus (valid/invalid), errorMessage, and whether the body was truncated.
Backend exposes a permission-gated query method to read the latest stored Worker0 stocks validation/inspection record without triggering a new HTTP outcall.
The implementation does not use the existing 16-chunk/64-call stocks chunk pipeline for this Worker0-only fetch.

requirements.text: Update the frontend Stocks market data path used by the Add-Asset search so it uses the new backend Worker0 stocks fetch/store/inspect flow (single endpoint only), and ensure the UI does not perform or describe any merge or marketCap-based sorting for stocks.

acceptanceCriteria: When MarketType is Stocks, the frontend triggers the Worker0-only backend fetch (single endpoint) and then reads the stored result for parsing into searchable stock assets.
The Stocks loading UI copy no longer references merging 4 VPS endpoints and no longer implies chunked fetching.
Frontend does not merge multiple stocks sources and does not sort stock results by marketCap as part of this Worker0-only fetch path.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Do not implement batching/chunking for the Worker0 stocks.json fetch; perform a single-request fetch.
Do not implement merging across multiple stock endpoints.
Do not implement sorting by marketCap for the stocks dataset as part of this change.
Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Implementing long-running (5–10 minute) canister execution; only the single HTTP fetch attempt and normal canister execution limits apply.
Adding background refresh scheduling for stocks.
Changing FIAT or Commodities fetching behavior.
Adding a new backend merge/sort pipeline for stocks beyond storing the Worker0 response as-is.
